svg.title: Detuning changes both frequency and oscillation height

cc:Work.dc:title: Detuning changes both frequency and oscillation height
cc:Work.dc:description: All traces start in zero under the constant-drive two-state model. Resonance reaches full inversion; detuning imposes a ceiling that changing duration cannot remove.
